effect_description_eng:
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and your opponent blocks if possible.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
＜Blocker＞ (At blocker timing, by suspending this Digimon, the opponent's attacking Digimon attacks it instead.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 3＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by placing 2 cards with [Gammamon] in their texts or the [VB] trait from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, give 1 of your opponent's Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." until their turn ends.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Proximamon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to this Digimon.
xros_req:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Gammamon] in text or w/[VB] trait: Cost 4
Assembly Requirements [Assembly -6] Lv.5 × Lv.4 × Lv.3, all w/[Gammamon] in text or w/[VB] trait
When this would be played, by placing the specified cards from the trash under it, reduce the play cost.
